description: Show the latest persisted connector-readiness reports, optionally for one connector. Use it to check whether an integration was set up and scored. Returns each report's status, score and timestamp; it is not a live credential or provider check.

connectorKey.description: Exact report key or metadata connector key to filter the latest 50 persisted reports; omit for all reports in that snapshot. Requires admin:org.

name: connector_health

configured.description: Whether this query found persisted readiness reports; not a live credential or provider-health check.

deepLink.description: EvalGate web path or absolute URL for inspecting these results.
